Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id prefixed with 'EFO:'), indication_label (mesh_heading), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4; mesh_heading = 'chronic kidney disease'. Sort: chembl_id ascending, pref_name ascending, canonical_smiles ascending, indication_curie ascending, indication_label ascending, max_phase_for_ind ascending.
